description:
WeatherMaster inspired by the Google Pixel weather app, but with more features
Features both the Pixel Weather-inspired design and the original Froggy style, with summaries, multiple weather and search providers, personalization options, and more.
Supported weather sources:
• Open Meteo
• Met Norway
• NWS
• SMHI
• DWD
• Meteo-France
• FMI
• ECCC
• BMKG
• China
• AccuWeather
• Meteo AM
• And more to be added
